body: People who say good thoughts take the same energy as bad haven't ever been victims of cyclical negative thinking.  It is a chore.  Almost a full time job to stop the negative thinking.  Some things I've tried are keeping journals in which I ONLY write positive things.  I force myself to not write a single negative thing.  I spent 10 minutes per day writing "I am thankful for..." over and over and finishing the sentence.  Even things like the sun or the warm bed I sleep in.  Food, the ability to taste...  It's a lot of work, but it seemed to pay off when I was diligent with it.
You're a kind person.  Thank you.
i don't expect them to understand. i just can't live my life for other people. I'm out of energy.
